- Total revenue TW was £61.8k versus LW £55.3k, a WoW increase of 11.8%.
- Total units TW reached 21,178 compared to 18,670 LW, while orders were nearly flat at 1,154 TW versus 1,153 LW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led all products TW with £8.4k revenue, a 13.6% share and rank 1.
- EDWARDIAN PARASOL BLACK ranked second in TW revenue at £3.4k, holding a 5.6% share.
- FAIRY CAKE CANDLES generated £3.1k TW revenue with a 5.0% share, closely followed by RED/WHITE DOTS RUFFLED UMBRELLA at £3.0k and 4.9% share.
- EDWARDIAN PARASOL NATURAL posted £2.9k TW revenue, a 4.7% share.
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME had the largest WoW revenue increase at 185.5%, followed by WILLOW BRANCH LIGHTS at 185.0% WoW.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS saw the steepest WoW decline at -61.8%, with WHITE CHERRY LIGHTS down 54.1% WoW.
